profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer interested in creating applications and processes that improve experiences for everyone.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
· Allowed employees to account for additional financial information by creating a new ASP.NET MVC project that interacted with the existing software to retrieve information for financial tables that could save edits back to the database via a jQuery front end.
· Improved functionality of Microsoft SQL Server database by adding scheduled stored procedures and creating customized SQL Server Reporting Services reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
· Wrote Java code to interact with separate services to improve cart and checkout processes.
· Collaborated with team members and leaders to clarify and, if necessary, add to design decisions during agile development sprints.
· Utilized Maven to build, Jetty to run, Postman to test, and Eclipse to debug Java Spring Boot based projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
· Wrote and modified tests in C to achieve decision level code coverage for Garmin's alert logging system for aviation equipment under the DO-178B Standard.
· Updated requirements and wrote tests in C for Garmin's aviation system failure alerts.
· Used GitHub to check code in and out for above tests; Added and updated GitHub submodules to upgrade testing tools.
